Algebra 1 · Unit 3: Linear Relationships

Positive and Negative Slope

Classify slopes as positive, negative, zero or undefined, and connect each to the direction of a line.

What you’ll learn

  • Classify a slope as positive, negative, zero or undefined
  • Connect the sign of slope to the direction of a line
  • Explain why a vertical line has undefined slope

The mountain biking connection

Climbing, descending, flat and a vertical drop are the four kinds of slope on a trail profile.

Learning activities

Interactive lab · from Algebra 1: Slope and Rate of Change

Map the Line

The MTB Ride Data Lab (the Slope & Linear Relationships Lab, extended): map a trail network on the coordinate plane, plot GPS and elevation data, measure slope and grade with the rise-over-run visualizer, read climbs, descents and flats, tell linear from nonlinear data, and discover y = kx at a steady pace. Includes the original slope practice bank and transfer challenge.

Level
Beginner to Advanced
Time
40-55 min
  • 6 stages
  • Mountain map and GPS plotting
  • Linked map and elevation profile
  • Rise-over-run visualizer
  • Trail profile designer
  • Ride data dashboard
  • Ultimate Ride Analysis Challenge (14)
  • Original practice bank (32)

Practises here: Classify a slope as positive, negative, zero or undefined; Connect the sign of slope to the direction of a line; Explain why a vertical line has undefined slope

Opens at: Stage 4: Read the Terrain · or start from the beginning
